title: Structure and stability of new N7 isomers
authors: X. Wang, Y. Ren, M.-B. Shuai, N.-B. Wong, W.-K. Li, A.-M. Tian

species.method: B3LYP/6-31G* (also UHF, MP2, B3LYP/6-311+G* given -- full Z-matrix at all 4 levels in Table 1)
species.source_note: Table 1 (molecule 1, Cs) -- full internal coordinates (bonds+angles+dihedrals) given

bond_params.note: FULL Z-matrix given (bond lengths R + angles A + dihedrals T), sufficient to reconstruct exact 3D geometry deterministically, not just approximate topology
bond_params.shape: boat-shaped 7-membered ring (atoms 1,2,5,6 coplanar); contains N=N double bonds (R12,R47 ~1.25 A)

species.notes: Level-dependent stability: genuine local minimum at UHF/6-31G* and UMP2/6-31G*, but a TRANSITION STATE (1 imaginary freq) at B3LYP/6-31G* and B3LYP/6-311+G*. B3LYP total energy -382.9422 au. Flag as method-dependent when using for comparison.

bond_params.shape: fused bicyclic: atoms 1,2,3,4,5 form a 5-membered ring (planar), atoms 3,5,6,7 form a 4-membered ring; similar to the N8(Cs) isomer of Gagliardi. Atom 3 and 5 are each bonded to 3 N atoms.

species.notes: Genuine local minimum at ALL four levels (UHF, UMP2, B3LYP/6-31G*, B3LYP/6-311+G*) -- 'possible candidate of stable N7 isomers'. B3LYP total energy -382.9579 au (2nd lowest of the 6). Lowest freq 221 cm-1 at B3LYP/6-311+G*.

bond_params.shape: 'w-shaped' twisted open chain; R12/R67~1.14 A close to N2 triple bond, R23/R56 close to N=N double bond

species.notes: CONFIRMED DUPLICATE: this is explicitly identified by the authors as the SAME structure as the 'twisted open-chain N7' of Li et al. 1998 (= N7_iso7_Cs_chain / N7_iso7_C2_chain in N7.json from N7.pdf) -- paper states 'the final optimized structure was with C2v symmetry... whose energies and geometry parameters are same as the results of Cs and C2 structures in reference [47]'. B3LYP total energy -383.0303 au, IDENTICAL to N7.json's iso7 entries. Genuine minimum at all 4 levels, lowest energy of all 6 here. DO NOT double-count in the new-structures pool -- this is the same global-minimum N7 species reported independently by a second paper as a consistency check.

NOT a good stable candidate: minimum only at UMP2/6-31G* level; TRANSITION STATE (imaginary freq) at UHF/6-31G*, B3LYP/6-31G*, AND B3LYP/6-311+G*. B3LYP total energy -382.8488 au (highest/least stable of the 6 after structure 5). Include for completeness but flag as method-dependent/mostly unstable.

bond_params.shape: pure single-bonded N7 cluster (only isomer with no double-bond character); atom 7 bonded to only one other N

species.notes: Genuine local minimum at ALL four levels -- explicitly confirmed stable by the authors. B3LYP total energy -382.8346 au (highest energy = least stable of the 6, expected since no multiple-bond stabilization).

bond_params.shape: fused bicyclic: 5-membered ring + 3-membered ring, atom 5 bonded to 4 other N atoms (highest connectivity)

species.notes: Level-dependent: minimum at UHF/UMP2 but TRANSITION STATE (2 imaginary freqs at B3LYP/6-31G*, 1 at B3LYP/6-311+G*, 843i cm-1) at DFT levels -- authors attribute instability to atom 5's unusually high (4-fold) connectivity. B3LYP total energy -382.9416 au.
